purpose: Rebuild Japanese surface-combatant and submarine physical/readiness wallets from realized Branch events rather than historical loss-date inheritance; close narrative-only damage slots; identify remaining submarine uncertainty before Eastern Fleet simulation.
precedence_note: This v003 replaces v002 for 1944-01-01 wallet work. Surface hull center is retained; global submarine center is rebuilt from the 1-Jan-1944 historical organization/dead-node baseline plus named Branch loss-path changes, Sentaka construction and explicit opportunity cost.
method: Start from ships actually completed by the date.
Retain historical losses only where the causal theater/route/event still exists or a Branch-specific event recreates the loss.
Restore ships whose historical loss depended on absent Guadalcanal/Solomons/Rabaul/New-Guinea emergency chains unless a Branch substitute loss is realized.
Book Branch-specific Midway/New-Caledonia/Efate/Bengal/GALVANIC damage and losses explicitly.
Separate physical hull existence, machinery/crew readiness, mission allocation and theater-transfer availability.
Do not use the old July-1944 legacy DD roster as authority where it conflicts with current Branch-specific loss assignments.

I-178.cause: US ASW during Efate withdrawal/refueling-line action
I-178.reason: Legacy Efate settlement explicitly booked one conventional I-boat loss; I-178 is the strongest geographic/temporal fit and its historical loss was already in the same Efate/New-Hebrides danger area.

Ko-4.reason: Legacy Efate settlement explicitly booked one first-generation Sentaka damaged; assigning Ko-4 preserves the late-Jul six-boat ready gate after repair.

RO-35.cause: US destroyer/air ASW after contact-preservation patrol
RO-35.reason: Provides the one additional H2 attrition slot supported by the earlier summer 0-2 loss band without re-importing the historical Santo loss geometry; a medium RO boat is the best fit for the middle observation line.

I-179_WORKUP_1943.incident: late-workup flooding/vent-status near-miss; checklist/status-board discipline prevents historical catastrophic loss
I-179_WORKUP_1943.note: Do not count as an experienced forward boat on 1 Jan.

fleet_destroyer_reconciliation.definition: modern fleet-type DD line: Fubuki/Akatsuki through Shimakaze; older Kamikaze/Mutsuki/Minekaze types are separate local-escort/transport pool
fleet_destroyer_reconciliation.allocation_note: Ready does not mean transferable. Carrier screens, Central Pacific reaction, South-Pacific bases, tanker/convoy protection and local fleets consume many hulls.
fleet_destroyer_reconciliation.comparison_to_old_planning_band: The Sep-1943 planning band 58-66 undercounted Jan-1944 physical hulls because it did not yet close absent-event Solomon losses hull-by-hull. Current settlements contain only three Branch-specific permanent modern-DD substitute losses (Yudachi, Natsugumo, Fubuki) plus retained non-Solomon losses listed above; do not force the new ledger back into the old band.

branch_loss_logic.Tenryu: historical Madang reinforcement loss not inherited because Branch PNG campaign geometry differs after Port Moresby capture
branch_loss_logic.Sendai: historical Empress Augusta Bay loss absent

readiness_1944_01_01.Yahagi: WORKUP; completed 1943-12-29, not Jan-early expeditionary asset
readiness_1944_01_01.Kinu: operational at frontier but carries near-term Singapore refit/maintenance debt
readiness_1944_01_01.Oi_Kitakami: local transport/training/refit-oriented, useful but not preferred young combat layer
readiness_1944_01_01.Agano_Noshiro_Oyodo: no current-Branch damage/commitment found that blocks Jan movement; individual origin/route still must be assigned

historical_1944_01_01_baseline.sensitivity: 71-72 because RO-38 loss date/status was historically uncertain
historical_1944_01_01_baseline.note: Using the 1 Jan 1944 IJN organization as the counting frame prevents double-counting training/reserve boats and exposes the wartime paper-roster lag.

branch_deltas_to_historical_physical.late_conventional_schedule_ripple_sensit: 0 to -1 hull around Jan1; center 0 pending exact yard-tail assignment

readiness_layers_1944_01_01.not_immediately_expeditionary: home-district reserve/training boats, new-workup boats, Yanagi boats, overhaul/repair boats and specialist test hulls
readiness_layers_1944_01_01.do_not_flat_multiply: The earlier 1.4-1.6x effective-patrol-power anchor was spring-1943 theater output, not a permanent readiness multiplier.

jan1_indian_ocean_local_clock.JAN7_EFFECT: 5 boats on patrol or outbound without any Pacific transfer
jan1_indian_ocean_local_clock.JAN10_TO_15_ESCALATION: I-27 and I-37 can be activated as Eastern-Fleet warning rises, giving ~7 active/outbound conventional boats before using Sentaka.

sentaka_rule.west_transfer_ready: 1-2 only after RN eastbound contact quality justifies stale-contact sprint/recontact role
sentaka_rule.efate_damage_note: Ko-4 repaired by late July 1943, so all six first-generation hulls are physically available again by year-end subject to normal maintenance.

submarine_reconciliation.paper_roster_liaison_effect: Historical Jan-1944 paper organizations carried several already-lost boats. Branch survival plus better status discipline reduces false silent-node ambiguity: a missing report is less often an unknowable sunk-vs-radio-failure case, improving contact-network confidence even before any tactical performance gain.

warship_construction_correction.kaibokan: quantity difference is modest under FOUNDATIONAL_BASELINE_REAUDIT_1944-01-01_v001; delete old 36-42 completion claim. Main effect is better availability/doctrine and gradual separation of slow-convoy escort from fleet DD

warship_construction_correction.Taiho: Feb-1944 completion then work-up; not Jan asset
warship_construction_correction.Ibuki: heavy cruiser path, late Jun/early Jul 1944; not Jan asset

remaining_hard_close_items: Exact 1942 individual identity behind the already-settled +2 year-end net survival delta can remain provenance-level unless a later named boat dependency requires it; I-30 is separately named and booked.
Assign exact Jan-1944 origin/route for Oyodo and the selected survival-dividend DD group before issuing movement orders.
Promote this ledger into CURRENT only when the Eastern Fleet signal timeline actually opens; no full package is generated at this working stage.
